name: Ind Agiv Commerce Limited
about: Ind Agiv Commerce Limited provides installation and commissioning services for audiovisual system integration and distributes paint products in India. It also offers solutions for meeting and training rooms, boardrooms, and auditoriums, as well as digital signage or video wall, multimedia or display systems, audiovisual venues, and interactive or control systems. The company was formerly known as Vishal Electro-Mach (India) Ltd and changed its name to Ind Agiv Commerce Limited in May 2004. Ind Agiv Commerce Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
